---

### Milestones

- **M0: process** — the spec system itself: schema, meta-spec ([SPEC-0000](./specs/0000-how-we-write-specs.md)),
  the linter ([SPEC-0002](./specs/0002-spec-linter.md)), and the epic/sub-spec model
  ([SPEC-0003](./specs/0003-epic-and-subspec-model.md)).
- **M1: packaging** — turn the single `wt.py` into a proper installable package with a
  clean module layout and XDG-based config/data locations, with zero loss of current
  functionality. *(done — [SPEC-0001](./specs/0001-package-refactor-and-xdg-layout.md))*
- **M2: tasks** — org-mode task management ([SPEC-0004](./specs/0004-org-task-management.md)
  epic): a read-only `Task` model over the user's org files (SPEC-0005), `wt tasks` +
  `wt agenda` (SPEC-0006/0007), the time→task join + digests (SPEC-0008), and safe TODO-state
  write-back (SPEC-0009). The payoff: joining already-tracked time to org tasks by JIRA key.
  Also: `wt add` to capture new work items ([SPEC-0010](./specs/0010-wt-add-capture.md)).
- **M3: idea→spec pipeline** — complete the work-lifecycle funnel
  ([SPEC-0011](./specs/0011-idea-to-spec-pipeline.md) epic): first-class **ideas** in org
  (SPEC-0012), **idea→spec** promotion (SPEC-0013), **spec→task** generation (SPEC-0014), and
  the strategic **outbound spec factory** — portable specs exported by file-drop into other
  repos for their agents to implement (SPEC-0015), with **pluggable export schemes** so a spec
  can be rendered into a foreign consumer's shape via a selected export scheme (SPEC-0016).
  Plus installable **agent workflow skills** so the pipeline is drivable from a fresh session
  without reading `wt`'s code (SPEC-0017). Layer 1 = 0012–0014; Layer 2 = 0015 (file-drop) +
  0016 (multi-scheme adapters); 0017 = usability.
- **M4: cli ergonomics** — shell completion and other day-to-day CLI polish
  ([SPEC-0022](./specs/0022-i-want-to-automatically-generate-comprehensive.md)).
- **M4+** — further features (to be specced): e.g. a git-commit collector, JIRA-worklog
  export, per-topic dashboards.
